name: Chapter 898. Persons in jail on civil process
scope: chapter Wis. Stat. ch. 898 (Legislative Reference Bureau, chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: The prisoner, after being so discharged, shall be forever exempt from arrest or imprisonment for the same debt unless the prisoner shall be convicted for having willfully sworn falsely upon his or her examination aforesaid or in taking the oath before prescribed.

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
plain-words.quote_longest: At the time and place specified in the notice the person shall be taken, under the custody of the jailer, the sheriff or the sheriff’s deputy, before the circuit judge or circuit court commissioner, who shall examine the prisoner on oath concerning his or her estate and effects a

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: If the prisoner is unable to pay in whole or in part the fees of the circuit court in the proceedings, the proceedings shall continue without charge to the prisoner.
